messages:
alex: Heads up 1 Im relocating from NYC to Lisbon on Sep 1. How does that affect my PTO accrual, my 2 unused floating holidays, and the Q4 company shutdown blackout?

mia_peopleops: Congrats on the move! Long answer short: accrual rate switches on your HR effective relocation date (the date in the relocation ticket). Floating holidays don't auto-convert to local bank holidays. You can request swaps or use them as PTO.

alex: if my relocation date is Sep 1, and Q4 blackout starts Dec 20, do I lose the ability to swap those floaters into local bank days?

sasha_manager: From a team perspective: we try to honor pre-approved PTO that existed before a blackout. If Alex files swap/approval before the blackout cutoff, we should be able to make accommodations.

jon_payroll: FYI : balances are shown under your current policy until HR processes the move. We prorate accruals for the month of the move (pro-rated by days under each country policy). If you see incorrect hours after the date, open a payroll ticket.

alex: what's the cutoff for filing a swap/exception so I don't get caught by the blackout?

mia_peopleops: Best practice: submit relocation + PTO-swap form at least 30 days before the blackout start. If you're within 30 days we still can approve but need manager sign-off + People Ops approval. Use: https://intranet.redwood.com/hr/forms/intl-pto-swap (choose "Relocation").

ops-bot: Reminder: submit forms 10 business days before any requested leave for manual review. Missing docs may delay processing.

jon_payroll: Note on carryover: carryover allowances follow the accrual period you were on when days were earned. So any days earned under US policy carry into the carryover rules for US accrual year even after you switch (we track by accrual period).

alex: so if I earned a floating holiday in Aug under US policy, I can still use it after Sep 1 but I need to request a swap?

mia_peopleops: Exactly. You can either: 1) take it as PTO; 2) request a floating-day swap to align with Portuguese bank holidays (subject to approval); or 3) take payout if your role/policy allows end-of-year encashment (check policy).

sasha_manager: Im fine to approve swaps as long as we have coverage. Alex, please add preferred dates in the form and cc me so I can sign quickly.

alex: will do. One more: will my unused US floating holidays auto-convert to the Lisbon roster for the year-end shutdown coverage?

mia_peopleops: No automatic conversion. For the shutdown we treat floats like PTO requests. If you need an exception because of relocation timing, request a blackout exception with manager note and People Ops will review. Exceptions granted for relocation are common but not guaranteed.

alex: thanks. I'll file the relocation ticket today and fill the swap form, cc @sasha. Appreciate the quick answers :slightly_smiling_face:

jon_payroll: Quick checklist for you: 1) submit relocation form (HR ticket), 2) file intl-pto-swap form, 3) include exact dates and manager sign-off, 4) confirm final balances after HR processes change.

ops-bot: Automatic follow-up: if forms are submitted, react with :white_check_mark: to confirm.

alex: submitted relocation ticket and filled swap form, cc'd @sasha. Reacted with :white_check_mark:.

mia_peopleops: Got it, we'll review and loop in payroll if needed. Welcome to Lisbon in advance! :earth_americas:
